report.summary: 4 confirmed findings, 1 narrowed; plan: fix _human_bytes PiB bug, implement available_vendors, ensure SearchReport always includes matches, verify _emit_ok calls in slice.py, refactor ROOT to use a config module for robustness.
risks: available_vendors may be defined elsewhere; implementing it could duplicate logic.
Fixing _human_bytes changes output for sizes >= 1024 TiB; may affect callers expecting TiB.
Adding 'matches' to SearchReport may require changes in multiple return sites.
Refactoring ROOT may break other files using parents[2] pattern.
todos: Implement available_vendors in vendors.py or locate existing implementation.
Fix _human_bytes to handle PiB and higher units.
Audit all SearchReport returns in embeddings.py for 'matches' field.
Add default to next() in lint.py compare() to avoid StopIteration.
Verify and enforce _emit_ok calls in slice.py.
Refactor ROOT definition to a shared config module.

items.title: Implement available_vendors function in vendors.py
items.why_now: Breaks any code that calls available_vendors; critical for vendor configuration.

steps.do: Open daedalus/memory/vendors.py and implement available_vendors returning a list of vendor names.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'def available_vendors' daedalus/memory/vendors.py && python -c "from daedalus.memory.vendors import available_vendors; assert len(available_vendors()) > 0"

items.assumption: vendors.py is at daedalus/memory/vendors.py; if not, locate actual path.

items.title: Fix _human_bytes to return PiB for sizes >= 1024 TiB
items.why_now: Returns TiB instead of PiB for large sizes, causing misrepresentation.

steps.do: Modify _human_bytes to not return at TiB; allow iteration to higher units.

items.assumption: File containing _human_bytes is unknown; likely in daedalus/memory/ or daedalus/utils/.

items.title: Ensure all SearchReport returns include 'matches' field
items.why_now: Missing 'matches' causes StopIteration in lint.py compare().

steps.do: Inspect lines 1499-1503 of daedalus/memory/embeddings.py and add 'matches' to SearchReport if missing.
Add default empty list to next() call in lint.py compare() to avoid StopIteration.

items.assumption: lint.py is at daedalus/memory/lint.py; if not, locate.

items.title: Verify and enforce _emit_ok calls in slice.py
items.why_now: Egress gates may not be enforced for emission paths.

steps.do: Search full slice.py for calls to _emit_ok; add calls where emission occurs.

items.title: Refactor ROOT definition to a shared config module
items.why_now: Current parents[2] pattern is fragile to directory depth changes.

steps.do: Create a config module (e.g., daedalus/config.py) with ROOT derived from __file__.
steps.verified_by: python -c "from daedalus.config import ROOT; assert ROOT.exists()"

steps.do: Replace ROOT in daedalus/memory/__init__.py and daedalus/spine/ledger.py with import from config.
Update daedalus/spine/ledger.py to import ROOT from config.

items.assumption: Adding a new module is acceptable; existing ROOT usage is limited to these two files.
